main_text.p: nisi post sanatum vulnus, eo quòd aquæ vulneri essent noxiæ Ievamot fol.45. 2.
§. Nec quidem lavabantur immundi quàm interdiu Megillah fol. 20.1.
§. Profelytum non baptizabant Sabbatho aut die festo. Maymon. Iffure biah c. 13.

§. In illo Baptismo præsentes esse debent tres discipuli sapientum, qui rem rite præstandam caveant, & Catechumenum paucis instruant; toti negotio tanquam testes adsint. Ievamot f. 46.2. Nos in nostro baptismo tres testes in cæhabemus, Patrem, Filium, & Spiritum Sanctum.
§. [illegible, ~12 letters] Noxii sunt profelyti Israeli sicut scabies Ievamot fol. 47. 2: plurimi enim pristinorum morum tenaces, legis Israeliticæ imperiti, dogmata & bonos mores corruperunt.
§.Baptizandus erat profelytus in tali מקוה aquarũ congregatione, quæ aliàs idonea erat abluedæ menstruosæ. (de qua vid. Lavabatur homo.)

§. Alii אותו טבילין ipsum baptizabant, vel הוא שובל ille ipse se immergebat merstone unâ; & tali ut & apex digiti capillique perfectè mergerentur. Nam si quis se totum abluerit, excepto minimi digiti apice, adhuc immundus censebatur. Maymon. Hal. מקואות c. 1.&.4.
§. In diebus R. Iosuæ Ben Levi conati sunt quidam extirpare hanc immersionem, fœminarum Galilæarum gratiâ, eo quòd illæ præ frigore sterilescerent.Hierof.Berac.fol.6.3.

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek passages are only approximated; the Hebrew in the §. line after "Noxii" and the Hebrew phrases in the Baptizandus and Alii paragraphs could not be read letter by letter. The Hebrew "קשיים גרים לישראל כספחת" in the line before "Noxii" is printed right-to-left and is shown as illegible. The Hebrew "מקוה", "מקואות" and "הוא שובל" are approximations of the print.
